evidence.arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
evidence.translation_en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts find peace.

evidence.arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ
evidence.translation_en: So remember Me; I will remember you.

evidence.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا
evidence.translation_en: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance.

evidence.arabic: فَإِذَا قَضَيْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمْ
evidence.translation_en: And when you have completed the prayer, remember Allah standing, sitting, or on your sides.

evidence.arabic: وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ
evidence.translation_en: And the remembrance of Allah is greater.

sub_sections.heading: How is Dhikr different from Dua?

evidence.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
evidence.translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

evidence.arabic: ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
evidence.translation_en: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

evidence.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
evidence.translation_en: And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for him.

evidence.arabic: فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ
evidence.translation_en: And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah.

evidence.arabic: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
evidence.translation_en: And upon Allah let the reliant rely.

evidence.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
evidence.translation_en: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs

evidence.arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Say, 'Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us; He is our protector.' And upon Allah let the believers rely.

evidence.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
evidence.translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

evidence.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
evidence.translation_en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, my Lord is Near and Responsive.

evidence.arabic: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ
evidence.translation_en: And He is with you wherever you are.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.

evidence.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
evidence.translation_en: And We send down of the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers.

evidence.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِّمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ
evidence.translation_en: O mankind, there has come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the chests.

evidence.arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
evidence.translation_en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts find peace.

evidence.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدًى وَشِفَاءٌ
evidence.translation_en: Say, 'It is, for those who believe, a guidance and healing.'

evidence.arabic: اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
evidence.translation_en: Allah has sent down the best statement, a consistent Book in which is reiteration. The skins shiver from it of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah
